vivian_ae: Opening Verdant POC perf thread. Prospect acceptance: sustain 700 qps, p95 < 140ms, show encryption impact and leave room for a 10% burst. Need a short runbook, smoke numbers, and a POC hourly estimate for AE.
samir_eng: Recommend rdx-4b-quant on dedicated pool. Typical payloads ~280 tokens in / ~110 out. Plan: 8m warmup, 30m steady, 5m 10% burst.
olga_sre: Cluster sizing: start 11 nodes. Warmup script: `./warmup_kv.sh --keys=12000 --clients=25 --duration=8m`. Use Poisson arrivals from 3 generators.
ben_sec: KMS note: we'll demo two modes: cached-envelope (prod mode) and strict-unwrap (audit mode). Add a short QA blurb about key rotation and audit forwarding.
samir_eng: Simple load example (vegeta): `vegeta attack -rate=700 -duration=30m -targets=targets.txt | vegeta report -type="hist[0,50,100,150,300,500,1000]" > run.txt`
deploy-bot: perf-job-verdant-4976543210 started on cluster-dedicated-11.
olga_sre: Smoke (warm cache): baseline p95 ~105ms, cached-envelope p95 ~128ms, strict-unwrap p95 ~165ms. p99 strict ~420ms. Throughput stable at 700 qps.
vivian_ae: Nice. Can someone convert perf delta to cost impact $/1M tokens and hourly POC cost? Also need artifacts URL for AE.
ben_sec: Security blurb draft: "Customer CMKs live in their KMS. Redwood uses envelope encryption; ephemeral envelope keys are cached per-node for performance. Unwraps use the customer's KMS; unwrap/key-use events are logged and can be forwarded to customer's audit endpoint. Envelope keys rotate every 24h; CMK rotation follows customer policy. Support for cloud/on-prem HSMs and attestation available."
olga_sre: Cost sketch: node $2.90/hr -> 11 nodes ~= $31.90/hr. Cached-envelope ~= +12% compute -> +$0.14 per 1M tokens. Strict-unwrap ~= +36% -> +$0.40 per 1M tokens (includes KMS egress). Artifacts: s3://perf-artifacts/verdant/4976543210/{run.txt,gpu-cpu-metrics.tar.gz,run-summary.png}
vivian_ae: Action items: samir run one encrypted+unencrypted full 30m variant and upload artifacts, ben finalize QA blurb, olga confirm node config and warmup script. I'll assemble AE pack once artifacts land. :thumbsup:
